system: You write company summaries for a team that vets companies before choosing them as suppliers or project partners. Data is as of 31 December 2025.
text:
**Prima Global Builders Sdn. Bhd.** (Reg: SYN-001560) is an active private limited construction company incorporated in Selangor on 29 October 2023. Its primary business focuses on office renovation and interior works (*"Pengubahsuaian dan kerja dalaman pejabat"*), backed by a share capital of 1,000,000 MYR. 

The company is led by four directors, with Director 2 (49.22%), Director 3 (29.62%), and Director 4 (20.54%) holding the majority equity. 

For the financial year ending 31 December 2024, the company recorded a revenue of 4.16 million MYR with a gross profit margin of 16.0%. However, it posted a net loss of 199,449 MYR due to operating expenses. Financial health indicators show a healthy quick ratio (1.39) and clean audit opinion, though operational cash flow was negative (-30,647 MYR) and borrowings stand at 1.14 million MYR. 

No active litigation cases are recorded against the company.
